rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for buying or obtaining something by paying for it.

example.english: I want to purchase a new mobile phone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial noun for the act of buying something.

example.english: I spent over a thousand dollars on the purchase today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 maai5 je5 jung6 zo2 seng4 cin1 man1

rows.note: Use this for the actual thing or things that someone has bought.

example.english: These are the things from my purchase yesterday.
example.traditional: 呢啲就係我尋日買返嚟嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 zau6 hai6 ngo5 cam4 jat6 maai5 faan1 lei4 ge3 je5
